title: Poisson occupancy of paths on permuted regular graphs
summary: In the classical occupancy problem, $B$ balls are placed independently and uniformly into $d$ boxes. We study a graph analogue of this model. Let $G$ be a directed $r$-regular graph on $d$ vertices and fix a vertex $i$. Consider all paths of length $L$ starting from $i$, and let $N_L(i,j)$ denote the number of such paths ending at a vertex $j$. Thus the vertices play the role of boxes and the $r^L$ paths play the role of balls. In general, these occupancies depend strongly on the geometry of $G$.
